title: Jaffna Kings hammer 221 to seal third straight win
byline: Jaffna Kings continued their impressive run in the Lanka Premier League 2026 with a commanding 21-run victory over Kandy Royals at the Pallekele International Cricket Stadium on Thursday, securing their third consecutive win.

title: Men’s Cricket World Cup 2027 venues and brand revealed
byline: ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup makes its much-anticipated return to Africa after 24 years, with the event set to take place across three countries.

title: Wilpattu National Park affected by drought
byline: The Wilpattu National Park has turned into a parched up region owing to the prevailing drought with all water resources running dry.

title: 26 retired police dogs to be auctioned in Kandy
byline: Twenty-six retired police dogs attached to the Asgiriya Police Kennel Division will be auctioned to the public on August 1, police said.

title: Leopards roam Peradeniya Uni; Students urged to stay alert
byline: Students and the staff of Peradeniya University are facing the danger of leopards that roam into the campus at night from the Hanthana hill range.

title: Govt. to permit private sector to purchase dengue vaccine initially: Minister
byline: The Government is planning to permit the private sector to purchase the dengue vaccine once the approval was granted to the vaccine in Sri Lanka, Health Minister Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa said yesterday.

title: Extending judges’ retirement age affecting judicial independence a false argument: Nalinda
byline: Claiming that various factions can have different opinions when constitutional amendments or amendment to certain Acts are brought, Health Minister Nalinda Jayatissa reiterated yesterday that the government has a mandate to provide relief to people by reducing backlog of cases in courts.

title: Sri Lanka to face vegetable shortage?
byline: Sri Lanka is beginning to face shortage of vegetables with the dry spell that is prevailing, traders said yesterday.

title: RDA tender process under fire
byline: As Sri Lanka moves ahead with the Central Expressway Project (CEP 4) and the Ruwanpura Expressway, a senior engineer involved in the project has questioned why the Road Development Authority (RDA), the Ministry of Transport and Highways, and the National Procurement Commission have not allowed proper competition to be followed in the tender process.

title: Trump says ’Board of Peace’ reaches Gaza disarmament deal
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Thursday his so-called ’’Board of Peace’’ ​reached an agreement for the complete disarmament ‌of Palestinian Hamas militants and other armed groups in Gaza.

title: Verdict due on Hemasiri, Pujith over Easter Sunday attacks
byline: The Colombo Permanent High Court Trial-at-Bar is scheduled to deliver its verdict today (July 31) in the case against former Defence Secretary Hemasiri Fernando and former Inspector General of Police (IGP) Pujith Jayasundara.

title: World-famous climber Nirmal Purja among 10 missing after avalanche atop Pakistan peak
byline: Ten mountaineers, including a Texas woman, led by world-famous climber Nirmal Purja, are missing after an avalanche on Pakistan’s Broad Peak — and an experienced American alpinist familiar with the conditions told The Post he feared the mountain could become a death trap.

title: ADB expands Sri Lanka reform loan to US$ 200mn as Middle East conflict strains recovery
byline: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has doubled its financing for Sri Lanka’s trade and investment reform programme to US$ 200 million, adding a US$ 100 million buffer to help the economy absorb pressures

title: Odel resumes Colombo 7 mall construction
byline: Odel PLC has resumed construction of the first phase of its long-delayed mall project in Colombo 7, with completion expected within the next one-and-a-half to two years.

title: Lalkantha asked me to keep silent on judges’ retirement age issue: Lal Wijenayake
byline: Senior lawyer Lal Wijenayake, a member of the Leadership Council, Executive Committee and National Operation Committee of the ruling National People’s Power (NPP), said yesterday that Agriculture Minister K.D. Lalkantha asked him to remain silent over the government’s move to extend the retirement age of superior court judges.

title: Cyanide in tomato pesticide killed 15 elephants in Kenya
byline: Fifteen elephants found dead in southern Kenya outside the Amboseli National Park are suspected to have been poisoned by eating tomatoes that had been sprayed with pesticides on nearby farms.

title: Strong winds, heavy rains in several areas today
byline: The Meteorology Department issued a strong wind advisory for the Northern, North-Central, North-Western, Sabaragamuwa and Central Provinces and the Moneragala, Hambantota and Trincomalee districts for 24 hours starting from 11 am today.

title: Sri Lanka’s Credit Rating: Progress Worth Recognizing, But Growth Requires Much More - Former Diplomat Kananathan
byline: S&P Global Ratings’ decision early this week  to affirm Sri Lanka’s long-term and short-term foreign and local currency sovereign credit ratings at CCC+/C, with a stable outlook, is undoubtedly a positive development. The agency cited the country’s resilience despite significant external challenges, reflecting the progress made since the economic collapse and sovereign default in 2022.

title: One killed, five injured in wasp attack
byline: A 61-year-old tea plantation worker was killed and five others were admitted to the Lindula Regional Hospital following a wasp attack on a group of workers employed at a tea plantation in the Lindula Police Division today.

title: Nation can only progress with young generation equipped with skills, vision: PM
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya said that a nation and society can only progress with a generation of young people equipped with skills and vision, and that it is essential to build the confidence of young people that opportunities exist for them while ensuring those opportunities become a reality.

title: At least 32 killed in Pakistan coal mine explosion, 10 remain trapped; labour union blames negligence
byline: A massive explosion in a coal mine in Pakistan on Thursday has killed at least 32 miners while trapping 10 others in life-threatening conditions, as per officials.

title: Nine dead as thousands of migrants enter Spanish enclave from Morocco
byline: The announcement comes after local authorities in Ceuta had asked the central government in Madrid for reinforcements to manage a border crisis that had been escalating before boiling over on Thursday, with large crowds breaching the border fence.

title: El Niño threat grows as Sri Lanka braces for climate risks
byline: Sri Lanka must prepare for possible severe weather impacts from the developing El Niño climate phenomenon, which could trigger extreme weather conditions globally, a senior climate expert has warned.

title: Senior Infantino adviser quits as AFC opposes plans
byline: Carlos Cordeiro said Infantino’s proposal was ’’a bad deal for football’’ and would ’’mortgage football’s future’’.

title: Jaffna journalists protest demanding justice for murdered media personnel
byline: Journalists in Jaffna staged a protest today demanding justice for murdered journalists and calling for impartial and credible investigations into the killings of media personnel, attacks on journalists, and violence against media institutions.

title: Railway catering firm fined Rs. 500,000 for overcharging water bottles
byline: The Anuradhapura Magistrate’s Court has imposed a fine of Rs. 500,000 on railway catering service provider for selling bottled drinking water above the government-approved Maximum Retail Price (MRP) on a train operating between Kankesanthurai and Colombo.

title: Four bodies located after 10 climbers go missing on Pakistani peak
byline: The bodies of four climbers have reportedly been located by Pakistani search crews after at least 10 mountaineers went missing in a suspected avalanche on Broad Peak a ⁠day earlier, officials said.

title: Lieutenant General Nilantha Premaratne appointed new Army Commander
byline: Lieutenant General Nilantha Premaratne has been appointed as the 26th Commander of the Sri Lanka Army by President Anura Kumara Dissanayake.

title: Sajith to host ’Sri Lankan Leopard Day’ tomorrow
byline: Leader of the Opposition, Sajith Premadasa, will host the ’Sri Lankan Leopard Day 2026’ tomorrow (1 Aigist) from 2.00 p.m. to 5.00 p.m. at the Opposition Leader’s office in Colombo 7, bringing together leading experts, policymakers, conservationists, researchers, government institutions, civil society organisations, the private sector and young people to strengthen national efforts to conserve the Sri Lankan leopard.

title: Police officer arrested over alleged anti-government social media posts
byline: A police officer attached to the Embilipitiya Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP) Office has been arrested by the Central Crime Investigation Bureau (CCIB) for allegedly circulating social media posts intended to cause embarrassment to the President and the government.

title: Brazil to play India in first international break after FIFA World Cup 2026
byline: Brazil will play friendlies against Australia and India in the first FIFA international break after the 2026 World Cup, the Brazilian federation confirmed on Wednesday.

title: Former Defence Secretary Hemasiri Fernando sentenced to death over Easter Sunday attacks
byline: The Colombo Trial-at-Bar today sentenced former Defence Secretary Hemasiri Fernando to death after finding him guilty on several charges, including criminal dereliction of duty for failing to take action to prevent the Easter Sunday terrorist attacks despite receiving prior intelligence warnings.

title: High-value crossings lift turnover as CSE ends week on a soft note
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) concluded the week with another subdued trading session, as both benchmark indices edged marginally lower amid cautious investor sentiment. Price movements remained largely range-bound throughout the day, while trading activity was dominated by high-value crossing transactions rather than broad-based market participation.

title: Heat advisory issued as public urged to stay hydrated
byline: The Department of Meteorology has issued a warm weather advisory for residents in the Eastern Province and the districts of Kilinochchi, Mullaittivu, Vavuniya, Polonnaruwa and Monaragala.

title: Former IGP Pujith Jayasundara sentenced to death over Easter Sunday attacks
byline: The Colombo Trial-at-Bar today sentenced former Inspector General of Police (IGP) Pujith Jayasundara to death after finding him guilty on several charges, including criminal dereliction of duty for failing to take action to prevent the Easter Sunday terrorist attacks, despite receiving prior intelligence warnings.

title: French Bar Council backs BASL’s concerns over proposed judicial retirement age increase
byline: The French National Bar Council (Conseil National des Barreaux – CNB) has adopted a resolution expressing support for the Bar Association of Sri Lanka (BASL) over concerns regarding the Government’s proposal to increase the retirement age of judges.

title: No fuel price revision for August
byline: There will be no revision to fuel prices for the month of August, Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) Chairman D.J. Rajakaruna said.

title: One injured in shooting near Mirissa Junction
byline:
One person was injured in a shooting incident near Mirissa Junction on Friday (31), Police Media said.

The condition of the injured person has not yet been disclosed.

The motive for the shooting and the identity of the suspects have not yet been established

title: Ex-Police Chief, Defence Secretary taken to prison after death sentence
byline: Former Inspector General of Police (IGP) Pujith Jayasundara and former Defence Secretary Hemasiri Fernando were taken to prison on Friday after the Colombo Permanent High Court Trial-at-Bar sentenced them to death over their failure to prevent the 2019 Easter Sunday terrorist attacks despite receiving prior intelligence warnings.

title: At least 25 people killed in Algeria bus crash
byline: At least 25 people have been killed and dozens of others injured in Algeria after a passenger bus overturned near the coastal town of Boumerdes, east of the capital Algiers, on Friday, local officials said.

title: Sri Lanka reviews roadmap to achieve US$5 bn digital exports by 2030
byline: Sri Lanka on Friday (31) reviewed a strategic roadmap aimed at increasing the country’s digital export earnings to US$5 billion by 2030, during a national workshop attended by key industry stakeholders.

title: Govt moves to confiscate illegal assets worth Rs. 3.8 bn seized since 2024
byline: The Government has initiated legal action to vest with the State illegal assets worth Rs. 3,811 million seized between 2024 and 2026 as part of the ongoing nationwide anti-drug operation, Police Spokesman Assistant Superintendent of Police (ASP) F.U. Wootler said.

title: French Bar Council backs BASL’s concerns over proposed judicial retirement age increase
byline: The French National Bar Council (Conseil National des Barreaux – CNB) has adopted a resolution expressing support for the Bar Association of Sri Lanka (BASL) over concerns regarding the Government’s proposal to increase the retirement age of judges.
